learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to draw human figures running, jumping, and playing using magical stick lines and bending joints!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Before we draw a detailed person, we use a simple stick figure as our skeleton. It helps us plan where the arms, legs, and head will go!
To make a person look like they are running or jumping, we have to bend their elbows and knees. Straight lines look still, but bent lines show action!
Once our action stick figure is ready, we can outline it to make the body thicker and then draw cool clothes, hair, and shoes over it.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Action Pose Challenge!
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your sibling or friend to freeze in a funny sports pose. Quickly draw their pose using a stick figure, making sure to bend the knees and elbows correctly!

quick_recap: ⭐ Stick figures act like a skeleton to help us plan our drawing.
⭐ Bending the lines at the joints shows that the person is moving.
⭐ We add thickness and clothes only after the action pose is perfect.
